title.zh: 词向量 · 把词摆成地图
title.en: Word Embeddings · Words as a Map

desc.zh: 一个词怎样变成一串数字？数字怎样衡量相似、做类比，机器又怎样不靠手工特征，从「常和谁在一起」里学出它们。
desc.en: How does a word become a list of numbers? How do the numbers measure similarity and solve analogies, and how can a machine learn them from “who a word keeps company with” instead of hand-made features?
